description:
As an AirBnb website user, I want to search for destination using the search bar, So that I can quickly find relevant hotel room according to the check-in/check-out dates.

Destination search Bar :

When I navigate to [+https://www.airbnb.co.in/,+|https://www.airbnb.co.in/,] The destination search bar should be visible and functional on the website.
Then I enter "Chennai, Tamil Nadu" as my destination.

Check-in, Check-out dates :

When I enter check-in date as 01-12-2026, Then I select 04-12-2026 as check-out date.
The dates provided should be selected seamlessly.

Adding guests :

When I click on add guests button, Then the corresponding section should be expanded along with multiple options to select.
And I select 3 adults as guests.

Acceptance Criteria:

Multiple search results should be populated in the screen, When I select first option from the results, wait for the page to load properly.
Then validate selected search result should be relevant for provided destination, along with selected check-in/check-out dates and exact guests count.
